items.name: Agent capability catalogue
items.description: Answer tool/capability questions without dispatching project work.

items.name: Agent tool pool
items.description: Assemble the current project-aware tool pool, grouped by core, deferred, disabled, and approval-required tools.

items.name: Agent tool search
items.description: Search and lazily discover available agent tools by domain, risk, name, description, or required input.

items.name: Session context reader
items.description: Inspect the current session ledger, recent messages, tasks, events, artifacts, and approvals.

items.name: Natural-language project execution
items.description: Turn a user request into governed agent_batch tasks that can call search, source_library, ingest, and workflow handoff paths.

items.name: Source library discovery
items.description: Inspect available project and shared source-library data-source items from the database before execution.

items.name: Source library search
items.description: Search available source-library items without executing collection.

items.name: Source library item inspector
items.description: Read one source-library item definition without running it.

items.name: Project summary reader
items.description: Read the local project database and summarize project-scoped data, source-library coverage, and session counters.

items.name: Project structured-data search
items.description: Search or inventory already-stored structured project data across documents, extracted JSON, graph nodes, market metrics, products, prices, resource-pool entries, keyword memory, search history, and sources.

items.name: Agent artifact search
items.description: Search session artifacts without mutating project state.

items.name: Agent artifact reader
items.description: Read a session artifact payload for conversational follow-up.

items.name: Workflow graph discovery
items.description: List compiled workflow graphs and workflow graph templates without executing a run.

items.name: Workflow graph inspector
items.description: Inspect compiled workflow graph nodes, order, checksum, and input shape before execution.

items.name: Ingest status reader
items.description: Read recent ingest and source-library job status without starting collection.

items.name: Source-library collection
items.description: Execute selected source-library items through ingest/source-library runtime.

items.name: Workflow graph execution
items.description: Run a compiled workflow graph and project node progress into agent sessions.

items.name: Report draft generation
items.description: Generate a report draft from existing session/project evidence and write the markdown output to a declared artifact path.

items.name: Task/session cancellation
items.description: Cancel the current agent session when the user explicitly asks to stop or abort.

items.name: Task retry
items.description: Retry a failed, canceled, or expired task in the current agent session.

items.name: Task continue
items.description: Continue a waiting or partially completed session through a coordinator pass.

items.name: Interactive event stream
items.description: Read session-scoped task, message, artifact, and approval progress through SSE.
